meaning:
ἐκ-κλείω
[in LXX: ἐ. κρίσιν, for נָטָה hi., Exo.23:2 (also as seel., Job.34:20, Psa.67:1-7 (Psa.68:30) * ;]
to shut out: Gal.4:17. Pass., Rom.3:27.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
